title: PaywithGHO
tagline: Streamlined Payments, Seamless Transactions with easy onramp solution 🎉
description: # PaywithGHO Streamlined Payments, Seamless Transactions with easy onramp solution 🎉 Tooling to simplify the experience of sending and receiving payments with GHO, and utilizing the unique features of GHO TOKEN like credit delegation and over collateralized lending and borrowing. Our Project increases accessibility of GHO by making it possible to wrap and Stream the token OR send and borrow from AA wallet (safe) | This feature abstracts and simplify user experience of our Users Onramp and Off ramp AA wallet GHO Lending and borrowing ## Features Account Abstraction based interaction with the AAVEV3 Pool - Users can connect with their Google Account , Easy Onboarding and get access to their Safe ERC-4337 Account with which on our Dapp they can easily interact with AAVEV3 Pool and do things like supplying , borrowing , repay. Seamless Payments with GHO - Users can seamlessly send payments to each other in the form of GHO Tokens by wrapping and streaming the GHO Tokens.' permit based borrows and supplies with ERC-4337 wallet (Safe) Credit delegation for the users Wrapping and Streaming GHO Tokens every min to the users Onramp and Off Ramp powered by monerium ## Seamless Onramp and Offramp using Monerium https://goerli.etherscan.io/tx/0x34409cfae69b786a04b5da8337dcdb0cc7be4ef04140ad9a0b8ef18342553b92 For offramp, you need to convert your asset into EURe which is an E-money for EUR. You can convert this using Uniswap Widget on our dapp. After successfull swap, you need to connect to Monerium. You can log in to monerium using PAY with IBAN feature. Our dapp uses Monerium for allowing users to offramp easily from their safe wallet. You can also transfer EURe from your safe wallet to other person's IBAN using the form present in our dapp. After you successfully swap GHO to EURe using the Widget and logged into Monerium. It directly shows your EURe money into your monerium Account.
